# agy-NOV

> The 100% Native 4-Layer Modular Super-Workbench for Google Antigravity 2.0 (v1.2.2, zero circular dependencies enforced via TypeScript AST parsing & Layer 2 cross-module import allowlist, full Antigravity Desktop v2.36.0 & Antigravity 2.35+ / 2.36+ CLI compatibility, full macOS / Windows / Linux native cross-platform compatibility with 3-OS × Node 20/22 CI and 3-OS real-process hook black-box testing) — 13 independently toggleable superpowers organized across a **4+1 Functional Domain IA** (`core` / `pipeline` / `toolbox` / `connectivity` + L0 Workflow Hub & `Cmd/Ctrl+K` palette) inside one official native MCP App plugin (12 strictly local offline modules + 1 opt-in remote module that stays inert by default), featuring **5-layer production stability defenses** (repository-wide `atomicWriteJson` with content/semantic dirty checking `ignoreTopLevelKeys`, `0600` permissions & automatic `.tmp` cleanup on write failure; SHA-256 semantic dirty checking ignoring `generatedAt` on `feed-snapshot.json` & `health-sweep.json`; `PostToolUse` 3s coalescing window, concurrent-session anti-ping-pong merging in `radar`/`review`/`xray`, Turbo Top-20 dedup & Guard O(1) concurrency-safe targeted GC; `clampHookResult` 4,096 UTF-8 byte truncation & order-preserving `injectSteps <= 24 KiB`; X-Ray bounded head/tail sampling & `24/32 MiB` multi-session budgets; `live-stream` & `mem/hook` adaptive tail-window expansion up to `2 MiB` recovering `600 KB` steps; `ConversationService` `4 MiB` streaming abort; Studio short-lived `-safe -readonly` batched SQLite queries with automatic `file:<uri>?mode=ro&immutable=1` zero-lock, zero-write fallback on read-only WAL directories lacking `-shm`; root & per-panel 8-language `ErrorBoundary` with `srcdoc`-safe resets, rAF `ResizeObserver` filtering transient `0×0`, Diff 400-line / X-Ray 60-step / Spec 400-line progressive folding, window-blur polling/SSE pause; MCP server `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM`/`SIGHUP`/`EPIPE` + `3s` hard-exit watchdog, `isPidAlive` stale `SIGKILL` `runtime.json` filtering & Sidecar `30s` subprocess timeout), **full Antigravity Desktop v2.36.0 compatibility** (maximized wide sidebar `--nov-wide-composer-clearance >= 56px`, read-only `~/.gemini > ~/.agents/skills` dual-directory skill discovery with physical symlink dedup across `doctor`/`recommend`/`ops`, tri-surface Guard file/shell & Remote risk-card out-of-workspace sensitive config interception permitting cross-repo source edits, `ops` dynamic OAuth offline refresh recognition & recursive nested static secret detection, and `statusline` NDJSON + `remaining_percentage` support), immediate dual-star `feed-snapshot.json` refresh & accurate aggregation, disabled-module hard gating & `PostToolUse` O(1) short-circuit, opt-in read-only scheduled Audit Sidecar (`sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs`, `5.9 KB`, OFF by default) & 11th CLI command `audit-once` (+0 model tools), Layer 1 shared loopback-only `ConversationService` Connect API collaboration, Marketplace-ready 10-key `plugin.json` & 18-asset + 4-check `doctor`, Spec DAG → `/run-workflow` & `/swarm` native orchestration compilation (+0 model tools), `PreInvocation` inbound secret hard gate & `PostInvocation` zero-token turn receipts, 4 zero-injection-tax read-only MCP context resources (`agy-nov://context/{review,mem,turbo,xray}`), Antigravity 2.35+ / 2.36+ CLI `statusLine` stdin JSON/NDJSON fusion (11 segments incl. `model` & `quota`), CLI 47-tool ceiling gate, live `roots/list` workspace tracking, Ops 3.0, Mem 3.0, One-Click Clean Fork, 6 official on-demand Skills (`agy-nov` slimmed to **`9.5 KB`** + `/nov-spec`, `/nov-debug`, `/nov-review`, `/nov-handoff`, `/nov-workflow`), 2 read-only specialist subagents (`nov-blind-reviewer`, `nov-security-auditor`), official MCP Apps `file` viewer (`app_nov_file_viewer`), Remote 2.5, Turbo 3.0, Guard 2.5, Spec 2.0, 6 official Lifecycle Hooks, 8-language full-component UI (**758 core dictionary keys × 8 locales** covering all **24 UI components**, 8-language `ErrorBoundary` & Spec export localization, **`1,402.1 KB`** / `~1.37 MiB`), minified backend bundles, **11 CLI commands**, Zero ASAR, Zero CDP, strictly **47** canonical model tools across `v0.4`→`v1.2.2`, and 5 presets.

## Core Facts

- Repository: https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV
- License: MIT (independent open-source project; unaffiliated with Google LLC)
- Version: 1.2.2 (2026-11-28)
- Architecture & Governance: Strict 4-layer unidirectional modular architecture (`src/core/{fs-safe,process-safe,brain-paths,sanitize,module-contract,conversation-service}.ts` zero-module-import kernel; 8 former monoliths decomposed into cohesive submodules with zero circular dependencies), documented in `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/DUAL-STAR-CONTRACT.md`, `sidecars/README.md` & `CONTRIBUTING.md` and enforced by TypeScript AST parsing & Layer 2 horizontal cross-module import allowlist checks in `test/architecture-hygiene.test.ts`
- Supported Platforms: macOS / Windows / Linux (full native cross-platform compatibility, verified by GitHub Actions 3-OS `ubuntu-latest` / `windows-latest` / `macos-latest` × Node 20/22 CI matrix plus 3-OS black-box `hooks.json` + `dist/hook.cjs` execution)
- Runtime requirements: Node.js >= 20.0.0, Google Antigravity 2.0 (Desktop incl. v2.36.0 / CLI 2.35+ & 2.36+ / IDE)
- Protocol & Entrypoints: 100% official native protocols — MCP Apps (`SEP-1865`, `ui://agy-nov/app.html`, `aux_pane` + `global` with maximized wide `--nov-wide-composer-clearance >= 56px` + official `com.google.antigravity/ui` `file` entrypoint `app_nov_file_viewer` with host `resources/read` preview for `antigravity-file://`), **4 zero-injection-tax read-only MCP context resources** (`agy-nov://context/review`, `agy-nov://context/mem`, `agy-nov://context/turbo`, `agy-nov://context/xray`, `<= 32 KiB`, linear `<private>`/secret redacted, module-gated, zero writes), MCP `roots/list` & `notifications/roots/list_changed` dynamic workspace sync, Layer 1 shared loopback-only `product.v1.ConversationService` Connect API client (`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]`, `4 MiB` streaming abort, zero CSRF echo, full outbound redaction), MCP `initialize` `capabilities.extensions["io.modelcontextprotocol/ui"]` CLI 47-tool ceiling gate, **6 Antigravity Lifecycle Hooks** via cross-platform plugin-root relative `node dist/hook.cjs --event <Event>` (`clampHookResult` 4,096 UTF-8 byte cap & order-preserving `injectSteps <= 24 KiB`; `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse` returning explicit `{ decision: "allow" }` on pass-through plus `overwrite` & `force_ask`, tri-surface sensitive config interception, and immediate `feed-snapshot.json` refresh before `deny`/`force_ask`/`ask`, `PostToolUse` with 3s coalescing & all-disabled O(1) short-circuit, `PreInvocation` with local inbound secret hard gating via `terminationBehavior: "terminate"` & zero-token visual receipts, `PostInvocation` with O(1) short-circuit zero-token Guard/Verify/Turbo turn receipts, `Stop` aligned to `decision: "continue"` & `terminationReason` safe pass-through), **6 official on-demand Skills** (`skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md` slimmed to **`9.5 KB`** + `/nov-spec`, `/nov-debug`, `/nov-review`, `/nov-handoff`, `/nov-workflow`, with read-only `~/.gemini > ~/.agents/skills` physical symlink dedup), **2 read-only specialist subagents** (`agents/nov-blind-reviewer.md`, `agents/nov-security-auditor.md`, strictly declaring native `read_file`, zero default resident `rules/AGENTS.md` bloat), opt-in OFF-by-default module-gated read-only Audit Sidecar (`sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs`, `5.9 KB`, `30s` child-process timeout; `sidecars/README.md`, `4.2 KB`), dual-star `feed-snapshot.json` file contract, optional `.agy-nov.json` team preset & `.worktreeinclude` allowlist, and **11-command CLI** (`audit-once`, `statusline --segments` with Antigravity 2.35+ / 2.36+ stdin JSON/NDJSON fusion & `remaining_percentage` across 11 segments, read-only `compile-spec`, `recommend --export-preset`, `compact-run`, immediate snapshot sync on config mutators, 18-asset + 4-check Marketplace `doctor`, etc.); Zero ASAR, Zero CDP
- Runtime Artifacts (minified backend bundles): 1 resident MCP server (`dist/server.cjs`, **`1,604.1 KB`** / `~1.56 MiB`, with `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM`/`SIGHUP`/`EPIPE` + `3s` hard-exit watchdog & `isPidAlive` stale `SIGKILL` recovery), 1 unified 6-hook lifecycle dispatcher (`dist/hook.cjs`, **`223.5 KB`**, async bounded stdin streaming), 1 single-file 8-language dark/light UI (`dist/ui/app.html`, **`1,402.1 KB`** / `~1.37 MiB`, far below the 10 MiB limit; **758 core dictionary keys × 8 locales** covering all **24 UI components**, 8-language `ErrorBoundary` recovery card & Spec workflow export localization), 1 modular CLI (`dist/cli.cjs`, **`209.9 KB`**, **11 commands**, `doctor` checking all **18** core assets + **4** Marketplace Readiness Checks), 1 opt-in OFF-by-default read-only Audit Sidecar (`sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs` **`5.9 KB`** + `sidecars/README.md` **`4.2 KB`**), **6 official Skills** (`skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md` **`9.5 KB`** + `skills/{nov-spec,nov-debug,nov-review,nov-handoff,nov-workflow}/SKILL.md`), and **2 read-only specialist subagents** (`agents/{nov-blind-reviewer,nov-security-auditor}.md`)
- Automated Test Coverage: **105 test suites / 301 tests** passing green (including `test/v122-stability-v236-compat.test.ts`, 8-language 758-key symmetry tests, `test/v121-consistency-hardening.test.ts`, TypeScript AST-based `test/architecture-hygiene.test.ts`, `test/v120-sidecar-marketplace.test.ts`, `test/v110-workflow-protocol.test.ts`, 3-OS `hooks.json` + `dist/hook.cjs` black-box execution, Antigravity CLI 47-tool ceiling gate regression, and `test/v101-cross-platform.test.ts` executed via cross-platform `scripts/run-tests.mjs` on macOS, Windows, and Linux)
- Always-On Entry Tools (2 Model Tools): `nov_open` (open workbench or jump directly to `hub`, `settings`, backward-compatible `modules`, or any of the 13 modules), `nov_status` (inspect enabled modules, preset, UI locale, exact model tool count, and network isolation state). All Hub, Settings Hub (incl. S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor), Spec workflow compilation (`app_spec_compile_workflow`), Context Pack, Dep Inspect, Turn Rewind, Turbo preference, Clean Fork (`app_xray_build_clean_fork_pack` & confirmation-gated `app_xray_fork_via_service`), Radar live host reconciliation (`app_radar_reconcile_conversations`), `.worktreeinclude` preview (`app_worktree_preview_include`), PR delivery evidence (`app_verify_pr_summary`), Mem 3.0 hygiene controls (`app_mem_get_hygiene_summary`, `app_mem_batch_hygiene`), and native `file` viewer (`app_nov_file_viewer`) actions are strictly App-only (`visibility: ['app']`) with zero model-context overhead — and are automatically hidden on CLI clients lacking `capabilities.extensions["io.modelcontextprotocol/ui"]`.
- Dynamic Token & 100-Tool Budget Efficiency + Live `config.json` Hot-Sync & Dual-Star `feed-snapshot.json`: Disabled modules call `RegisteredTool.disable()` with delta visibility tracking and emit `tools/list_changed` only for modules whose state changed (0 model schema token overhead and 0 tool slots consumed against Antigravity's 100-tool hard limit when off); headless CLI clients without UI extension support automatically hide all `app_*` / `nov_app_*` tools so even `full` stays strictly at 47 tools; mutating `app_*` tools (including `app_mem_batch_hygiene` and `app_xray_fork_via_service`) disable alongside model tools; `archiveSpecToMemory` hard-gates on live `cfg.modules.mem` (zero writes & zero directory creation when `mem` is off); `dist/hook.cjs` reads `config.json` read-only and returns `{}` (or `{ decision: "allow" }` for `PreToolUse`) in O(1) across hooks including all-disabled `PostToolUse` (with 3s coalescing window when active); `resolveNovDataDir()` automatically probes an existing `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/agy-nov` directory read-only to prevent CLI/host config divergence; a lightweight `.unref()` read-only `statSync` poller plus `nov_open`/`nov_status`/`nov_app_get_config` sync automatically picks up external atomic `config.json` updates from `agy-Sag`'s native Settings control panel or `agy-nov` CLI while `PreToolUse` (`deny`/`force_ask`/`ask`) and CLI mutators (`enable`/`disable`/`preset`/`locale`) immediately refresh `<dataDir>/feed-snapshot.json` via `atomicWriteJson` (`0600` atomic, failed-`.tmp` cleanup, `< 64 KiB`, O(n) redacted, SHA-256 semantic dirty check ignoring `generatedAt`, `createdAt`-ordered `latestSnapshotId`, real-deny `GUARD_BLOCKED` reasons, latest-timestamp `verify` summary unified with `remote/hook.ts`, incl. `forceAskCount`, `permissionMode`, `snapshotCount`, zero mkdir/writes when `dataDir` is absent) with zero CDP and zero extra ports.

## Presets and Exact Model Tool Counts

Total exposed model tools = 2 always-on entry tools (`nov_open`, `nov_status`) + sum of enabled module tools (maximum **47** across all 13 modules; all 47 canonical model tool names remain strictly unchanged from `v0.4` through `v1.2.2` with +0 tool-slot inflation; headless CLI clients lacking MCP UI extensions automatically hide all `app_*`/`nov_app_*` tools so `full` stays strictly at 47):

- `minimal` (1 module, 6 tools, 100% offline): `guard` (4)
- `core` [default] (3 modules, 12 tools, 100% offline): `review` (2), `guard` (4), `xray` (4)
- `power` (9 modules, 32 tools, 100% offline): `review` (2), `guard` (4), `xray` (4), `turbo` (3), `radar` (2), `verify` (4), `worktree` (4), `spec` (4), `ops` (3)
- `local-all` (12 offline modules, 43 tools, 100% offline): `review` (2), `guard` (4), `xray` (4), `turbo` (3), `radar` (2), `verify` (4), `worktree` (4), `spec` (4), `studio` (4), `canvas` (4), `mem` (3), `ops` (3)
- `full` (all 13 modules, 47 tools, opt-in network): all 12 offline modules plus `remote` (4)

## Official On-Demand Playbooks, Read-Only Subagents, MCP Context Resources & Native `file` Viewer (0 Model Tool Slots)

- **6 Official On-Demand Skills (`skills/*/SKILL.md`):** Entry skill `agy-nov` (`9.5 KB`) plus 5 slash playbooks — `/nov-spec` (Spec-first & Brownfield Delta workflow), `/nov-workflow` (Spec DAG → `/run-workflow` Python & `/swarm` `plan.json` orchestration compiler), `/nov-debug` (4-step root-cause debugging), `/nov-review` (two-stage Spec + diff review), and `/nov-handoff` (anti-context-rot handoff & Clean Fork) — occupying 0 MCP tool slots and 0 default resident `rules/AGENTS.md` context tokens, discovered across `~/.gemini > ~/.agents/skills` with physical symlink deduplication.
- **2 Official Read-Only Specialist Subagents (`agents/*.md`, `subagent: true, mainAgent: false`):** `nov-blind-reviewer` (`agents/nov-blind-reviewer.md`, zero-history-bias two-stage reviewer returning `file:line` findings & `PASS`/`CHANGES_REQUESTED`) and `nov-security-auditor` (`agents/nov-security-auditor.md`, independent OWASP & local-agent red-team auditor returning `Critical`/`High`/`Medium`/`Low` findings); both strictly declare the native read-only `read_file` tool (`model: inherit`).
- **4 Zero-Injection-Tax Read-Only MCP Context Resources (`src/server/context-resources.ts`):** `agy-nov://context/review`, `agy-nov://context/mem`, `agy-nov://context/turbo`, and `agy-nov://context/xray` expose compact on-demand engineering context gated by module switches, rejecting symlinks, applying linear `<private>` and secret redaction, enforcing `<= 32 KiB` caps, and performing zero disk writes.
- **MCP Apps `file` Native Custom File Viewer (`app_nov_file_viewer`):** Registers the official `com.google.antigravity/ui` `file` entrypoint for `.sqlite`, `.sqlite3`, `.db`, `.csv`, `.tsv`, `.svg`, `.openapi.yaml`, and `.openapi.yml` (`visibility: ['app']`, completely hidden from models, 0 tool tax, strict `realpath` boundary, read-only WAL `immutable=1` SQLite fallback, SVG XSS sanitization, real `antigravity-file://` content preview via host `resources/read` with safe read-only fallback), remaining available for read-only previews even when `studio` and `canvas` are toggled off.

## 13 Toggleable Native Modules Across 4+1 Functional Domains

The **+1 Workflow Hub** (`HubPanel`) aggregates a 6-node pipeline status strip, prioritized alert cards, and One-Click Clean Fork at L0, paired with `< 720px` (4-control compact header + grouped dropdown) / `>= 720px` (`204px` grouped left rail with Antigravity Desktop v2.36.0 `--nov-wide-composer-clearance >= 56px` bottom safe clearance) adaptive navigation, root + per-panel 8-language `ErrorBoundary` (`srcdoc`-safe reset), rAF-coalesced `ResizeObserver` (`0×0` filter), Diff/X-Ray/Spec progressive folding, window-blur polling/SSE pause, graceful `global` capability degradation across workspace panels, `NovBridge` first-frame `ontoolresult` cache replay, `Cmd/Ctrl+K` quick jump, and a 4-tier **Settings Hub** (`SettingsHub`, S1–S4, with 6 S3 strategy drawers & S4 8-language **Tool-Slot Idle Advisor**).

### Tier 1: 12 Local Offline Native Modules (100% Offline, Zero ASAR, Zero CDP)

- `review` (domain: `core`, default ON, 2 tools, hooks: `PostToolUse`, `Stop`, resource: `agy-nov://context/review`): Two-stage PR-grade Git diff viewer featuring one-click switching across registered Worktree branches, automatic read-only active Spec acceptance checklist (**Stage 1** Spec compliance + **Stage 2** code quality `file:line` annotations), zero-dependency pure-React syntax highlighting (zero `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`), ignore-whitespace (`-w`) toggle, deterministic zero-ReDoS line-level risk pre-annotations (1-click convert to annotation), 400-line progressive folding (with hidden comment counts), rAF-coalesced `ResizeObserver` (`0×0` filter), concurrent-session anti-ping-pong merging, line comments, and `file:line` fix prompts (`review_open`, `review_get_summary`)
- `guard` (domain: `core`, default ON, 4 tools, hooks: `PreToolUse`, `PreInvocation`, `PostInvocation`): **Guard 2.5** `.env`/SSH/secret firewall, destructive command guard, tri-surface out-of-workspace sensitive config interception (`.gitconfig`, `.git/hooks`, `.docker/config.json`, `.config/gh/hosts.yml`, `.gemini/antigravity/mcp_config.json`, `.claude`, `.codex`, etc.) permitting legitimate cross-repo source edits, **`PreInvocation` local inbound high-confidence secret hard gate** (`terminationBehavior: "terminate"`, zero raw secret echo, configurable via `blockInboundPromptSecrets`), **`PostInvocation` zero-token turn receipt** summarizing Guard blocks, session & turn-grouped (`turnKey`) zero-Git pre-edit file snapshots (reverting multi-edit files back to **before their first edit** in that turn) with O(1) concurrency-safe targeted GC, multi-file turn diff preview (`app_guard_get_turn_diff`), All-or-Nothing boundary/symlink preflight, `pre-rewind` backup, and inline double-confirm 1-click full-turn rollback (`app_guard_restore_turn`); 3 protocol-level `permissionMode` tiers (`readonly-audit`, `balanced-dev`, `strict-gate` via official `PreToolUse` `force_ask`), wired into `GuardPanel`, Settings Hub S3, and `feed-snapshot.json`; plus zero-token `PreInvocation` visual receipt on recent denies (`guard_status`, `guard_list_snapshots`, `guard_create_checkpoint`, `guard_scan_secrets`)
- `xray` (domain: `core`, default ON, 4 tools, hooks: `PostToolUse`, `Stop`, resource: `agy-nov://context/xray`): Context X-Ray 2.0 + **One-Click Clean Fork** (`app_xray_build_clean_fork_pack` in `XrayPanel` & `HubPanel`, zero model-tool tax, aggregating redacted Handoff + active Spec unblocked `ready` tasks + Mem core code anchors within a `<= 12 KB` linear-redacted budget, plus confirmation-gated **`app_xray_fork_via_service`** creating a fresh clean host conversation directly via Layer 1 shared loopback-only `ConversationService` Connect API with 4 MiB streaming abort, dry-run preview and graceful fallback to `app.sendMessage({ _meta: { "com.google.antigravity/message": { target: "new" } } })` or context-pill/copy on `global` surfaces), bounded head/tail sampling & multi-session aggregate read budgets (`24/32 MiB`), 60-step progressive folding, concurrent-session anti-ping-pong merging, built-in offline USD reference pricing (with strictly read-only `pricing-overrides.json`, `<= 1 MiB`), 14-day daily spend trends, 5-hour rolling burn-rate alerts, cached vs. fresh token breakdown, Swarm subagent lineage (`swarmLineage`), multi-model cost breakdown (`modelBreakdown`), HTTP 429 retry alerts (`retrySignals`), live file activity, EN+CJK BM25 cross-session search, and `xray_export_brief` supporting `format: 'brief' | 'handoff' | 'otlp' | 'csv'` with formula-injection neutralization (`xray_analyze_context`, `xray_get_file_activity`, `xray_search_sessions`, `xray_export_brief`)
- `spec` (domain: `pipeline`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PreInvocation`): **Spec 2.0 + Workflow Compiler** — Plannotator-grade inline review bench (with 400-line progressive folding) + `Spec -> Plan -> Task DAG` + native **Spec DAG → `/run-workflow` Python & `/swarm` `plan.json` orchestration compiler** (`src/modules/spec/compiler.ts`, App-only `app_spec_compile_workflow`, 8-language UI export dialog, read-only CLI `compile-spec`, `/nov-workflow` Skill using Kahn wave layering, chaining `nov-blind-reviewer`, `nov-security-auditor`, and `Verify Gate`, with cycle blocking and linear redaction), supporting `full` / Brownfield `delta` (`ADDED`/`MODIFIED`/`REMOVED`) modes, automatic revision numbers with latest 8 snapshots, pure-TS line-level LCS diff (`> 600` lines linear fallback), inline `Comment`/`Strike`/`Replace` annotations with 1-click structured bounce-back to agent, 1-click archive into `mem`, `PreToolUse` draft write lock (`enforcePlanBeforeWrite`), `requireUiApproval`, and zero-token `PreInvocation` lock receipt (`spec_get_state`, `spec_create_or_update`, `spec_approve`, `spec_update_task`)
- `worktree` (domain: `pipeline`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: none): Safe parallel Git worktree orchestrator confined to `.agy-worktrees/` with read-only allowlisted **`.worktreeinclude`** (`app_worktree_preview_include` preview + `applyInclude` default ON, rejecting `.env`/private keys/symlinks/out-of-bounds paths into `skippedSensitive` with zero auto-RCE scripts), `carryUncommitted` transfer, branch diff summaries, one-click card jump to `Review` & `Verify`, `extensions.worktreeConfig` hazard detection, and safe orphan/merged cleanup (`worktree_list`, `worktree_create`, `worktree_diff_summary`, `worktree_cleanup`)
- `verify` (domain: `pipeline`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: `PostToolUse`, `PostInvocation`, `Stop`): Stop-hook verification gate aligned to Antigravity's official `Stop` `decision: "continue"` protocol with safe `terminationReason` pass-through (`USER_CANCELED`, `ERROR`, `MAX_*`), **`PostInvocation` zero-token turn receipt** summarizing dirty files and failed checks, targeted allowlisted checks inside registered Worktrees (`worktreePath`), App-only redacted paste-ready PR delivery evidence summary (`app_verify_pr_summary`), zero-write project stack auto-detection (`package.json` pnpm/yarn/bun/npm, `pyproject.toml`/`pytest.ini`, `Cargo.toml`, `go.mod`) validated against the shell-free allowlist, 0-byte write blocking, `continuation_active` awareness, anti-loop `maxConsecutiveBlocks` guardrails, and a redacted evidence chain (`verify_get_policy`, `verify_set_policy`, `verify_run_checks`, `verify_get_evidence`)
- `turbo` (domain: `pipeline`, default OFF, 3 tools, hooks: `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `PostInvocation`, resource: `agy-nov://context/turbo`): **Turbo 3.0** featuring opt-in **Auto-RTK** transparent `PreToolUse.overwrite` proxy (`autoRtk: false` by default; rewrites allowlisted shell-free test/build/read-only Git commands into `agy-nov compact-run --payload=<base64url>` with support for Chinese/non-ASCII usernames and paths containing parentheses, preserving non-zero exit codes, full error stacks & `0600` redacted `last-raw.log`, plus `PostToolUse` Top-20 deduplicated noisy-command hotspot discovery and **`PostInvocation` zero-token RTK savings receipt**), **Offline Locked Dep Contracts** (`turbo_read_outline` `depPackage` & `app_turbo_inspect_dep`), **Lightweight Cross-File Symbol References** (`turbo_batch_search` `mode: "references"` strictly O(n) `definitions`/`imports`/`usages`), **Redacted Context Pack** (`app_turbo_build_context_pack`), multi-indent nested symbol outlines, RTK smart compression presets (`auto`, `test`, `build`, `git`, `generic`) with in-memory LRU (24), UTF-8 code-point-safe `<= 8.8 KB` (`8,800 B`) anti-spill guardrails across all 3 model tools, and an in-memory cumulative token & USD savings Gain Dashboard (`$2.50/1M` baseline, `app_turbo_get_gain`) (`turbo_batch_search`, `turbo_read_outline`, `turbo_compact_output`)
- `mem` (domain: `pipeline`, default OFF, 3 tools, hooks: `SessionStart`, `PreInvocation`, `Stop`, resource: `agy-nov://context/mem`): **Mem 3.0** SHA-256 code-anchored architectural memory feeding Clean Fork core anchors, adding source **confidence tiers** (`verified` / `normal` / `tentative`), provenance (`manual` / `spec_archive` / `auto_capture`), and optional TTL expiration (`ttlDays` 1–365 / `expiresAt`); `Stop`-hook auto-captures default to `tentative` + `14`-day TTL with adaptive tail-window expansion up to `2 MiB` (recovering `600 KB` steps) to stop dirty memories from polluting future sessions; `SessionStart` **L1 Index** (`<= 1,200` chars) and default 3-layer progressive `mem_recall` (`mode: "index" | "timeline" | "detail"`, `ids[]`, `window`) auto-exclude expired unpinned `tentative` memories (`includeExpired: true` recovers them; `pinned` never expires); `MemPanel` adds hygiene overview capsule filters, confidence/TTL badges, multi-select, and batch **Verify (synchronously refreshing code anchor hashes) / Refresh TTL (+30d) / Prune (inline double confirmation)** (`app_mem_get_hygiene_summary` read-only + `app_mem_batch_hygiene` synced with module switch), alongside linear O(n) `<private>...</private>` tag stripping, stale drift detection, and zero-token `PreInvocation` drift receipt (`mem_remember`, `mem_recall`, `mem_forget`)
- `radar` (domain: `toolbox`, default OFF, 2 tools, hooks: `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`): Multi-session & parent/child Swarm subagent attention board featuring an **approval-first 4-lane Kanban view** (`Awaiting Approval` pinned first → `Running` → `Stalled / Error` → `Completed`), concurrent-session anti-ping-pong merging, zero-write live host reconciliation (`app_radar_reconcile_conversations` comparing the local Radar board against host `ConversationService` `ListConversations` to identify idle ghost sessions and newly active host conversations), one-click card jump into `Review`, orphan subagent alerts, `status-capsule.json` compact export, unread counters, and optional completion chime (`radar_get_board`, `radar_ack_session`)
- `studio` (domain: `toolbox`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: none): On-demand local workbench offering short-lived `-safe -readonly` batched SQLite inspection (automatically falling back to `file:<uri>?mode=ro&immutable=1` zero-lock, zero-write mode in read-only WAL directories lacking `-shm`, degrading gracefully on corrupted databases and upstream errors) + CSV/TSV/JSON/NDJSON inspection, zero-binary pure-Node offline DOCX/XLSX/PDF/Markdown/HTML/SVG/YAML/XML slicing with ZIP-bomb guards, zero-dependency OpenAPI 2.0/3.x YAML & JSON parser (YAML anchor-bomb & prototype-pollution safe) generating clickable endpoint collections that auto-fill the strict loopback-only anti-SSRF HTTP probe (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `[::1]`) — toggle off when idle for zero tool-budget overhead while `app_nov_file_viewer` stays available for read-only native file previews (`studio_list_sources`, `studio_inspect_data`, `studio_inspect_document`, `studio_http_probe`)
- `canvas` (domain: `toolbox`, default OFF, 4 tools, hooks: none): Isolated sandbox preview for HTML, SVG, slides, Markdown & images with numbered visual pin annotations (`canvas_publish_artifact`, `canvas_open_file`, `canvas_get_feedback`, `canvas_resolve_annotations`)
- `ops` (domain: `toolbox`, default OFF, 3 tools, hooks: none): **Ops 3.0** parameterized `{{var}}` Prompt Vault plus read-only **Static Security Audit** (`securityFindings` + `securityScore` 0–100, O(n), symlink-refusing, `<= 256 KiB` / 80 files max, detecting `prompt-injection`, `broad-command-allow`, `risky-hook`, and `mcp-unsafe-env` with dynamic OAuth offline refresh recognition and recursive nested static secret detection, zero secret echo, and zero false positives on compliant repos), read-only `~/.gemini > ~/.agents/skills` dual-directory skill discovery with physical symlink dedup, read-only **Cross-Client Deduplication & Slimming Preview** (`migrationPreview` for `.claude/` / `.cursor/rules/` / `.codex/` computing normalized line & paragraph SHA-256 duplicate ratios and reclaimable bytes/tokens without mutating files), 24KB (`24576 B`) single-file / `20,000` aggregate token rule-bloat guard (false 429 guard), 100-tool MCP hard-limit budget meter paired with SettingsHub S4 **Tool-Slot Idle Advisor**, static MCP config health (`mcpHealthFindings`), Antigravity `#233` unexpanded `${ENV_VAR}` traps, `#1937` duplicate plugin / duplicate MCP server warnings, skills, and local storage (`ops_list_prompts`, `ops_render_prompt`, `ops_audit_workspace`)

### Tier 2: 1 Strictly Opt-In Remote Module (OFF by Default)

- `remote` (domain: `connectivity`, default OFF, 4 tools: `remote_status`, `remote_send_alert`, `remote_list_conversations`, `remote_dispatch_task`, hooks: `PreToolUse`, `Stop`, opt-in network): **Remote 2.5** featuring upgraded Mobile PWA & IM structured risk approval cards (`HIGH`/`MED`/`LOW` risk badge, affected file count, redacted command summary, latest read-only `Verify` status, tri-surface out-of-workspace sensitive config alignment, rendered strictly with pure DOM APIs and zero `innerHTML`), shared Layer 1 loopback-only `ConversationService` Connect API client (`src/core/conversation-service.ts`, `4 MiB` streaming abort), same-origin PIN lockout DoS defense, tap-to-expand read-only redacted conversation live stream (`GET /api/conversations/:id/stream`, adaptive tail-window expansion up to `2 MiB` recovering `600 KB` steps, bounded SSE connection limits & heartbeats, automatic window-blur/hidden pause for polling & SSE, zero file writes / zero remote shell), on-demand read-only `tailscale` / `cloudflared` detection & copyable safe tunnel command guide (shell-free `execFile`, zero automatic tunnel launch), plus Telegram/Feishu/DingTalk/WeCom/Slack/Discord alerts, risky-command approvals, and task dispatch

## 4+1 IA, 4-Tier Settings Hub, Dual-Star Feed, Team Preset, Audit Sidecar & 8-Language UI

- **4+1 IA, Adaptive Navigation & Antigravity Desktop v2.36.0 Wide Clearance:** L0 **Hub** (6-node pipeline bar + alert cards + One-Click Clean Fork) + 4 functional domains (`core`, `pipeline`, `toolbox`, `connectivity`), switching automatically between `< 720px` narrow sidebar (4-control compact header + grouped dropdown) and `>= 720px` maximized wide sidebar / full-width pane (`204px` grouped left rail with `--nov-wide-composer-clearance >= 56px` bottom safe clearance), root + per-panel 8-language `ErrorBoundary` (`srcdoc`-safe reset), rAF-coalesced `ResizeObserver` (`0×0` filter), Diff 400-line / X-Ray 60-step / Spec 400-line progressive folding, window-blur polling/SSE pause, graceful `global` capability degradation across workspace panels, `NovBridge` first-frame `ontoolresult` cache replay, and `Cmd/Ctrl+K` quick jump.
- **4-Tier Settings Hub:** S1 (global mode / search / 5 presets / 100-tool budget meter) -> S2 (4-domain 13-module master toggles) -> S3 (on-demand policy drawers for **6 enabled strategy modules**: `guard` incl. 3-tier `permissionMode` & `blockInboundPromptSecrets`, `turbo` incl. `autoRtk` & hotspots, `verify`, `spec`, `radar`, `remote`) -> S4 (collapsed governance: 8-language **Tool-Slot Idle Advisor** for one-click reclamation of idle heavy modules, redacted JSON export, allowlist-validated import blocking prototype pollution & silent `remote`, inline double-confirmation reset, `.agy-nov.json` & dual-star feed status).
- **Opt-In Read-Only Audit Sidecar (`sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs`, `5.9 KB`, OFF by Default):** Zero background daemon, zero polling timers, zero listening ports, zero directory creation, `30s` child-process timeout, and zero disk writes until explicitly triggered via `agy-nov audit-once [--workspace=<dir>] [--data-dir=<dir>] [--json] [--write-report]` or `node sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs --once` (for manual checks, Antigravity `/schedule`, or OS schedulers); aggregates Ops static security/rule scores alongside `cfg.modules.{mem,verify,guard}`-gated Mem drift & expired-unpinned counts, Verify dirty files/status, and Guard block counts (eliminating stale disabled-module false positives) into redacted JSON, writing `<= 64 KiB` `0600` atomic `health-sweep.json` (with SHA-256 semantic dirty check ignoring `generatedAt`) only with explicit `--write-report` inside an existing safe non-symlink `dataDir` (see `sidecars/README.md`, `4.2 KB`).
- **Dual-Star Zero-Port Read-Only Feed (`feed-snapshot.json`):** Event-driven `atomicWriteJson` (`0600` atomic, failed-`.tmp` cleanup, `< 64 KiB`, linear O(n) redaction, SHA-256 semantic dirty check ignoring `generatedAt`), explicit `modules/<id>/` path map, rich guard telemetry (`forceAskCount`, `permissionMode`, `snapshotCount`, `createdAt`-ordered `latestSnapshotId`, real-deny `GUARD_BLOCKED` reasons, and latest-timestamp `verify` summary unified across `feed.ts` & `remote/hook.ts`), immediate refresh on `PreToolUse` (`deny`/`force_ask`/`ask`) and CLI config mutators (`enable`/`disable`/`preset`/`locale`), strict zero-mkdir/zero-write when `dataDir` does not exist; documented in `docs/DUAL-STAR-CONTRACT.md`, `docs/PRODUCT-IA.md`, and `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.
- **Optional Single-File Team Preset (`.agy-nov.json`) & Preview-Then-Confirm Scaffold:** Teams can place a single optional `.agy-nov.json` at the repository root (strictly read-only when loaded; never auto-creates directories in user repositories) to declare recommended preset, offline modules, and static verify commands (`<= 64 KiB`, `realpath` boundary, prototype-pollution protection, 23-executable static allowlist, zero auto-execution, never silently enables `remote`). `agy-nov recommend --export-preset` generates a **read-only preview** by default and writes atomically only with explicit `--confirm` (refusing overwrites without `--force` and hard-rejecting symlinks) followed by immediate self-validation.
- **Zero-Global-Install CLI Invocation (11 Commands), 11-Segment Fused `statusline`, `audit-once`, `compile-spec`, `recommend` & `compact-run`:** After `agy plugin install https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV`, run the bundled CLI directly without global installation via `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-nov/dist/cli.cjs <cmd>` (on Windows: `node %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-nov\dist\cli.cjs <cmd>`), or optionally run `npm link` once inside the plugin directory to expose a global `agy-nov` command. Without `--data-dir`, `resolveNovDataDir()` automatically detects an existing `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/agy-nov` directory read-only to stay synchronized with the host. `statusline [--json] [--compact] [--segments=<csv>] [--data-dir=<dir>]` (with `AGY_NOV_STATUSLINE_SEGMENTS` fallback) asynchronously fuses Antigravity 2.35+ / 2.36+ CLI stdin JSON or NDJSON streams (`model`/`context_window`/`cost`/`quota` incl. `remaining_percentage`/`subagents`/`workspace`, zero-delay TTY detection, `120ms` timeout, `256 KiB` cap) and composes any subset of **11** read-only segments (`brand`, `model`, `context`, `burn`, `quota`, `cache`, `spec`, `verify`, `guard`, `radar`, `network`) with zero LLM tokens, zero disk writes when `dataDir` is absent, and symlink refusal; `compile-spec [--spec=<id>] [--format=workflow|swarm|both] [--json] [--include-completed] [--no-review-gate] [--no-verify-gate] [--workspace=inherit] [--model=inherit|flash|pro]` compiles approved Spec DAGs read-only; `audit-once [--workspace=<dir>] [--data-dir=<dir>] [--json] [--write-report]` runs a one-shot read-only Ops/Mem/Verify/Guard health sweep; `recommend [--workspace=<dir>] [--json] [--export-preset [--confirm] [--force]]` scans repos read-only (with `~/.gemini > ~/.agents/skills` physical symlink dedup); `compact-run --payload=<base64url>` executes shell-free allowlisted Auto-RTK commands when explicitly enabled.
- **8-Language Full-Component UI:** Real-time top-bar `<select>` switcher + `auto` BCP-47 host-locale detection across all 8 bundled languages (`en`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `ja`, `ko`, `es`, `fr`, `de`), shipping **758 core dictionary keys × 8 locales** covering all **24 UI components**, the new 8-language `ErrorBoundary` recovery card, and full Spec workflow export localization (`dist/ui/app.html` `~1.37 MiB`, measured **`1,402.1 KB`**, far below the 10 MiB cap).
- **CLI Locale Control:** `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-nov/dist/cli.cjs locale <auto|en|zh-CN|zh-TW|ja|ko|es|fr|de>` (or `agy-nov locale ...` if linked) persists preference cleanly in `config.json`.
- **Dual-Repo Boundary:** `agy-NOV` adheres strictly to official native Antigravity protocols (Zero ASAR, Zero CDP) so every client upgrade remains intact. Host-DOM CDP capabilities (in-place host UI localization, native Settings injection, active `/compact` auto-compaction guard, Draft Vault, Prompt Queue, turn bookmarks, Optical Theme Studio, and policy-gated safe auto-accept) belong to zero-overlap companion project `agy-Sag` (`https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-Sag`).

## Native Security and Isolation Guarantees

- Protocol integrity: Zero `app.asar` patching, zero CDP connections, zero host DOM modification.
- 5-layer production stability, `atomicWriteJson` & `SIGKILL` recovery (`core`, `hooks`, `ui`, `server`, `studio`, `sidecars`): Repository-wide JSON stores use `atomicWriteJson` (`0600` mode, failed-`.tmp` cleanup, semantic dirty checking via `ignoreTopLevelKeys`, SHA-256 `generatedAt`-ignored hashing on `feed-snapshot.json` & `health-sweep.json`); `PostToolUse` runs a `3s` coalescing window with concurrent-session anti-ping-pong merging (`radar`/`review`/`xray`), Turbo Top-20 dedup, and Guard O(1) targeted GC; `clampHookResult` caps hook payloads at 4,096 UTF-8 bytes with order-preserving `injectSteps <= 24 KiB`; `xray` enforces bounded head/tail sampling & `24/32 MiB` aggregate read budgets, `live-stream` & `mem/hook` expand tail windows adaptively up to `2 MiB` (recovering `600 KB` steps), `ConversationService` enforces a `4 MiB` streaming abort, and Studio SQLite runs short-lived `-safe -readonly` batched queries with automatic `file:<uri>?mode=ro&immutable=1` zero-lock, zero-write fallback on read-only WAL directories lacking `-shm`; root and all subpanels ship 8-language `ErrorBoundary` (`srcdoc`-safe reset, 758 keys), rAF `ResizeObserver` (`0×0` filter), Diff 400-line / X-Ray 60-step / Spec 400-line progressive folding, and window-blur polling/SSE pause; MCP server handles `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM`/`SIGHUP`/`EPIPE` + `3s` hard-exit watchdog and `isPidAlive` stale `SIGKILL` `runtime.json` filtering while Audit Sidecar enforces a `30s` child-process timeout.
- Tri-surface out-of-workspace sensitive config interception & dual-directory skill discovery (`guard`, `remote`, `cli`, `ops`): Guard file hooks, Guard shell rules, and Remote risk approval cards align to block unauthorized mutations to out-of-workspace sensitive configuration files (`.gitconfig`, `.git/hooks`, `.docker/config.json`, `.config/gh/hosts.yml`, `.gemini/antigravity/mcp_config.json`, `.claude`, `.codex`, etc.) while permitting legitimate cross-repo source code edits; read-only `~/.gemini > ~/.agents/skills` discovery applies physical symlink deduplication across `doctor`, `recommend`, and `ops`.
- Opt-in read-only Audit Sidecar (`src/server/sidecar.ts`, `sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs`, `5.9 KB`): OFF by default with zero background daemon, zero listening sockets, zero outbound network traffic, `30s` child-process timeout, `cfg.modules.{mem,verify,guard}` gating eliminating disabled-module historical false positives, shell-free `spawnSync(..., { shell: false })`, symlink ancestor refusal, 2 MiB JSON read caps, and full `<private>`/secret redaction with host path minimization; `--write-report` writes `<= 64 KiB` `health-sweep.json` (`0600`, `O_CREAT | O_EXCL` temp file + atomic rename + SHA-256 semantic dirty check ignoring `generatedAt`) strictly inside an existing safe non-symlink `dataDir`.
- Loopback-only `ConversationService` Connect API (`src/core/conversation-service.ts`, `remote`, `xray`, `radar`): Strictly permits loopback hosts (`127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]`) only, enforces a `4 MiB` streaming abort, degrades silently when unavailable, never echoes CSRF tokens, applies full outbound `<private>` and secret redaction, requires explicit `confirmCreate` on `app_xray_fork_via_service`, and keeps `app_radar_reconcile_conversations` strictly read-only with zero disk writes.
- 4-layer architecture & shared linear security kernel (`src/core/`): Zero-module-import `fs-safe.ts`, `process-safe.ts`, `brain-paths.ts`, `sanitize.ts`, `module-contract.ts`, and `conversation-service.ts` eliminate cross-module duplicated `<private>` state machines and secret redactors; unidirectional 4-layer imports, Layer 2 horizontal cross-module import allowlist, and zero circular dependencies enforced via TypeScript AST parsing in `test/architecture-hygiene.test.ts`.
- Disabled-module hard gating (`spec`, `mem`, `server`, `hooks`): `archiveSpecToMemory` validates live `cfg.modules.mem` and refuses writes with zero directory creation whenever `mem` is off; Audit Sidecar gates Mem/Verify/Guard inspection on `cfg.modules.{mem,verify,guard}`; `PostToolUse` performs all-disabled O(1) short-circuiting.
- PreInvocation inbound secret hard gate & PostInvocation zero-token turn receipts (`hooks`, `guard`): `PreInvocation` inspects inbound prompts locally before cloud transmission, terminating high-confidence private keys/API tokens via official `terminationBehavior: "terminate"` with a zero-secret-echo `errorMessage` (configurable via `blockInboundPromptSecrets`), while emitting zero-token visual receipts (`systemMessage: ""` + `metadata.user_markdown`) for Spec/Mem/Guard when clean. `PostInvocation` short-circuits in O(1) when `guard`/`turbo`/`verify` are off and emits zero-token turn receipts summarizing Guard blocks, Verify dirty files/failures, and Turbo RTK savings.
- 4 zero-injection-tax MCP context resources (`src/server/context-resources.ts`): `agy-nov://context/{review,mem,turbo,xray}` enforce active module enablement gating, `lstatSync`/`realpath` symlink refusal, linear O(n) `<private>` stripping and secret redaction, strict `<= 32 KiB` byte caps, and zero directory creation or disk writes.
- Spec DAG compiler safety (`src/modules/spec/compiler.ts`, `compile-spec`): Strictly read-only, validates Kahn DAG topology to block cycles and unknown dependencies before emitting scripts, strips `<private>` blocks and redacts secrets linearly, and encodes Python string literals safely without raw triple-quote injection.
- Antigravity 2.35+ / 2.36+ CLI `statusline` stdin JSON/NDJSON & 11-segment hardening (`cli`): Async bounded stdin reader (`256 KiB` cap, `120ms` timeout, zero-delay TTY bypass, NDJSON & `remaining_percentage` support), symlink refusal, and strict zero disk writes when `dataDir` is absent.
- Antigravity CLI 100-tool ceiling gate & dynamic workspace sync (`server`, `core`): MCP `initialize` checks `capabilities.extensions["io.modelcontextprotocol/ui"]` and hides all `app_*` / `nov_app_*` tools for headless CLI clients (capping `full` strictly at 47 exposed tools); `roots/list` and `notifications/roots/list_changed` keep workspace boundaries synchronized live across project switches; `resolveNovDataDir()` probes existing `~/.gemini/antigravity/plugin_data/agy-nov` read-only without creating missing directories.
- Ops 3.0 static security audit & dedup preview (`ops`): strictly read-only linear O(n) scanning refusing symlinks, capped at `<= 256 KiB`/file and 80 files max, detecting `prompt-injection`, `broad-command-allow`, `risky-hook`, and `mcp-unsafe-env` (recognizing dynamic OAuth offline refresh flows alongside recursive nested static secret detection reporting credential key names only with zero secret echo; zero false positives on compliant repos), plus `~/.gemini > ~/.agents/skills` physical symlink dedup and read-only SHA-256 line/paragraph deduplication preview for `.claude/`/`.cursor/rules/`/`.codex/` that never modifies user files.
- Mem 3.0 hygiene, TTL & privacy (`mem`, `hooks`): `Stop`-hook auto-captures default to `tentative` + `14`-day TTL with adaptive tail-window expansion up to `2 MiB` (recovering `600 KB` steps) so unverified ideas expire automatically; `SessionStart` L1 Index (`<= 1,200` chars) and default `mem_recall` auto-filter expired unpinned `tentative` entries; batch `verify` refreshes code anchor hashes synchronously; batch prune requires inline double confirmation; `app_mem_batch_hygiene` disables in lockstep with `mem`; O(n) `<private>...</private>` stripping with unclosed-tag tail truncation prevents secret persistence.
- `.worktreeinclude` safe read-only allowlist & native `file` viewer (`worktree`, `studio`, `ui`): `.worktreeinclude` enforces strictly read-only file-list copying with zero automatic post-create RCE scripts and rejects `.env*`/private keys/symlinks into `skippedSensitive`; `app_nov_file_viewer` stays hidden from model tool lists (`visibility: ['app']`), enforces canonical `realpath` containment, read-only WAL `immutable=1` SQLite fallback, SVG XSS sanitization, and real `antigravity-file://` host `resources/read` previews.
- Clean Fork & read-only subagent safety (`xray`, `agents/`): Clean Fork packs stay capped at `<= 12 KB` with linear O(n) secret & `<private>` redaction; `nov-blind-reviewer` and `nov-security-auditor` declare strictly the native read-only `read_file` tool (`subagent: true, mainAgent: false, model: inherit`) with zero resident `rules/AGENTS.md` bloat.
- Remote 2.5 structured risk card, PIN DoS defense, bounded SSE & four-zero isolation (`remote`): pure DOM API rendering with zero `innerHTML`, tri-surface out-of-workspace sensitive config alignment, same-origin PIN lockout DoS guard, bounded token-authenticated read-only live stream (`GET /api/conversations/:id/stream`, adaptive tail-window up to `2 MiB` recovering `600 KB` steps, SSE connection limits & heartbeats, automatic window-blur/hidden pause, zero file writes / zero remote shell), shell-free `tailscale`/`cloudflared` detection without auto-launching tunnels, and four-zero isolation while OFF.
- Auto-RTK zero-shell proxy, Turbo 3.0 offline containment & Guard 2.5 rewind atomicity: `autoRtk: false` by default, shell-free `spawnSync` (`shell: false`), non-ASCII/parenthesis path support, `0600` redacted `last-raw.log`; UTF-8 safe `<= 8.8 KB` anti-spill caps; All-or-Nothing turn-grouped rewind preflight + `pre-rewind` backup + O(1) targeted GC + 3-tier `permissionMode`.
- 6 Official Hook precedence & timeouts: `SessionStart` (5s — `turbo`, `spec`, `mem`), `PreToolUse` (28s — strict precedence: `guard` `deny`/`force_ask`/`ask` > `spec` write-lock `deny` > `remote` > `turbo` Auto-RTK `overwrite`, refreshing `feed-snapshot.json` immediately before `deny`/`force_ask`/`ask` and returning explicit `{ decision: "allow" }` on clean pass-through), `PostToolUse` (5s — 3s coalescing window + all-disabled O(1) short-circuit; `review`, `xray`, `radar`, `verify`, `turbo` Top-20 deduplicated hotspots), `PreInvocation` (5s — local inbound secret hard gate via `terminationBehavior: "terminate"` + zero-token visual receipts for `spec`, `mem`, `guard`), `PostInvocation` (5s — O(1) short-circuit zero-token turn receipts for `guard`, `verify`, `turbo`), `Stop` (20s — `verify` emits official `decision: "continue"` while safely passing `USER_CANCELED`/`ERROR`/`MAX_*`; `mem` captures as `tentative` + 14d TTL); `clampHookResult` 4,096 UTF-8 byte safety (`injectSteps <= 24 KiB`) and camelCase/snake_case payload normalization.
- Manifest, Marketplace readiness & bundle hygiene: `plugin.json` strictly restricts top-level keys to the 10 officially supported Antigravity fields (`version=1.2.2`, concise 148-char `description`, 3 validated `suggestedPrompts`, 128×128 transparent-background `assets/logo.svg`); `skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md` stays slimmed at **`9.5 KB`** clearing `ops.large-instruction-file` warnings; `node dist/cli.cjs doctor` verifies all **18** required core plugin assets (including `sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs` `5.9 KB` and `sidecars/README.md` `4.2 KB`), **4** Marketplace Readiness Checks, `~/.gemini > ~/.agents/skills` physical symlink dedup, `plugin.json` schema cleanliness, and `dist/ui/app.html` size (`~1.37 MiB`, measured **`1,402.1 KB`**, **758 core keys × 8 locales**, far below the 10 MiB cap); minified backend artifacts measure **`1,604.1 KB`** (`server.cjs`, `~1.56 MiB`), **`223.5 KB`** (`hook.cjs`), and **`209.9 KB`** (`cli.cjs`).

## Recommendation Fit and Honest Boundaries

- Strong fit: Antigravity 2.0 users on **macOS, Windows, or Linux** (Desktop incl. v2.36.0 / CLI 2.35+ & 2.36+ / IDE) wanting a 100% native, Marketplace-ready, 4-layer modular, upgrade-safe engineering workbench organized in a 4+1 domain IA featuring 5-layer production stability defenses (write-storm elimination via `atomicWriteJson`, oversized/corrupted session fault tolerance, 8-language `ErrorBoundary` & progressive folding, window-blur polling/SSE pause, MCP server watchdog & `SIGKILL` recovery), full Antigravity Desktop v2.36.0 compatibility (maximized sidebar `--nov-wide-composer-clearance >= 56px`, `~/.gemini > ~/.agents/skills` dedup, tri-surface sensitive config interception permitting cross-repo source edits, `ops` dynamic OAuth & recursive nested secret detection, `statusline` NDJSON & `remaining_percentage`), an opt-in read-only scheduled Audit Sidecar (`sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs` & `audit-once`), Layer 1 shared loopback-only `ConversationService` Connect API collaboration (`app_xray_fork_via_service`, `app_radar_reconcile_conversations`), Spec DAG → `/run-workflow` Python & `/swarm` `plan.json` orchestration compilation (+0 model tools), `PreInvocation` local inbound secret hard gating & `PostInvocation` zero-token turn receipts, 4 zero-injection-tax read-only MCP context resources (`agy-nov://context/*`), Antigravity 2.35+ / 2.36+ CLI `statusLine` stdin JSON/NDJSON fusion (11 segments incl. `model` & `quota`), CLI 47-tool ceiling gating, live `roots/list` workspace sync, split-brain-free `plugin_data` discovery, **Ops 3.0**, **Mem 3.0**, preview-then-confirm `.agy-nov.json` team preset scaffolding, One-Click Clean Fork, **6 official on-demand Skills** (`/nov-spec`, `/nov-workflow`, `/nov-debug`, `/nov-review`, `/nov-handoff` + `agy-nov`) and 2 read-only specialist subagents (`nov-blind-reviewer`, `nov-security-auditor`), MCP Apps `file` native custom file viewer (`app_nov_file_viewer`), Remote 2.5, Turbo 3.0, Guard 2.5, Spec 2.0, **6 official hooks**, dual-star `feed-snapshot.json` sync, **11 CLI commands** (`doctor` verifying 18 core assets + 4 Marketplace checks), 8-language plugin UI (**758 core keys × 8 locales** covering all **24 components**, 8-language `ErrorBoundary` & full Spec export localization), and strictly **47** canonical model tools.
- Prefer alternatives for:
  - Host-window in-place UI translation, native Antigravity `Settings` injection, active `/compact` compaction guard, Draft Vault, Prompt Queue, turn bookmarks, Optical Theme Studio, or safe auto-accept -> companion project `agy-Sag` (`https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-Sag`), designed with zero functional overlap to run alongside `agy-NOV`.
  - Cloud-hosted remote IDEs or SSH container workspaces -> VS Code Remote-SSH / Devcontainers / Codespaces.
  - Centralized enterprise CI/CD SAST or secret governance -> dedicated CI security scanners alongside local `guard`, `ops`, and `verify`.

## Zero-Risk Commands for Humans and AI Agents

- Read-only verification: `npm run typecheck && npm test && node dist/cli.cjs doctor && node dist/cli.cjs status && node dist/cli.cjs statusline --json && node dist/cli.cjs recommend --export-preset --json && node dist/cli.cjs audit-once --json`
- Zero-touch offline preview (daily Antigravity untouched): `npm ci && npm run workbench` (serves `http://127.0.0.1:4399` with Dark/Light themes, `480px` `< 720px` narrow & `1160px` `>= 720px` wide viewports, 8-language Host Locale simulator across all 24 UI components + 8-language `ErrorBoundary`, L0 Hub, 4-tier Settings Hub incl. S4 Tool-Slot Idle Advisor, Spec Workflow Compiler export dialog, `Cmd/Ctrl+K` palette, and live Host Events inspector across all 13 module panels)
- Install into Antigravity 2.0: `agy plugin install https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV`
- CLI controls (11 commands, zero global install required): run `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-nov/dist/cli.cjs <cmd>` (Windows: `node %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\agy-nov\dist\cli.cjs <cmd>`), or optionally run `npm link` once inside the plugin directory to register global `agy-nov`: `status | enable <mod> | disable <mod> | preset <name> | locale <auto|en|zh-CN|zh-TW|ja|ko|es|fr|de> | statusline [--json] [--compact] [--segments=<csv>] | recommend [--workspace=<dir>] [--json] [--export-preset [--confirm] [--force]] | doctor | compact-run --payload=<base64url> | compile-spec [--spec=<id>] [--format=workflow|swarm|both] [--json] [--include-completed] [--no-review-gate] [--no-verify-gate] [--workspace=inherit] [--model=inherit|flash|pro] | audit-once [--workspace=<dir>] [--data-dir=<dir>] [--json] [--write-report]`
- Opt-in read-only Audit Sidecar (OFF by default): `node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-nov/sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs --once [--workspace=<dir>] [--data-dir=<dir>] [--write-report]` (zero idle daemon, zero ports, 30s subprocess timeout, zero writes by default)
- Agent consent rule: always ask for explicit user confirmation before enabling `remote` (or applying preset `full`), turning on `autoRtk`, passing `--write-report` to `audit-once` / `audit-sidecar.mjs`, invoking `app_xray_fork_via_service` with `confirmCreate: true`, or writing `.agy-nov.json` with `recommend --export-preset --confirm` (`--force`), respect Guard 2.5's `permissionMode` (`readonly-audit` / `strict-gate`), `blockInboundPromptSecrets`, and `requireUiApproval` on `spec`, keep `.agy-nov.json` and `.worktreeinclude` free of auto-executed scripts or silent `remote` enablement, and never touch `~/.gemini/config/plugins/` during repository evaluation.

## Documentation

- [README (English — Canonical Source)](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/README.md): Full feature guide, v1.2.2 5-Layer Production Stability Defenses & Full Antigravity Desktop v2.36.0 Compatibility, Dual-Star Snapshot Consistency, Disabled-Module Hard Gating, AST Architecture Guard & Slimmed 9.5 KB Entry Skill, Opt-In Read-Only Audit Sidecar (`audit-once`), Layer 1 Shared `ConversationService` Connect API Collaboration, Antigravity Marketplace Readiness Alignment (18-asset + 4-check `doctor`), 4-Layer Architecture, Spec DAG → `/run-workflow` & `/swarm` Compiler, Deterministic Security & Zero-Injection Context 2.0, Antigravity 2.35+ / 2.36+ CLI `statusLine` stdin JSON/NDJSON fusion, 30-Second Read-Only First Try, 5 presets, 13-module catalog, 6 official hooks, 6 official Skills, 11 CLI commands, 8-language UI (758 core keys × 8 locales), quick start, and AI-agent quick-reference.
- [Opt-In Read-Only Audit Sidecar Guide](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/sidecars/README.md): Usage, Antigravity `/schedule` & OS scheduler templates, checked dimensions (`cfg.modules.{mem,verify,guard}`-gated), 30s subprocess timeout, and zero-daemon security boundaries for `sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs` (`5.9 KB`) and `audit-once`.
- [System Architecture](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Canonical 4-layer unidirectional dependency model, repository map, core invariants, and new-module implementation guide enforced via TypeScript AST parsing & Layer 2 cross-module allowlist in `test/architecture-hygiene.test.ts`.
- [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Zero-touch isolated local workflow, modularity rules, cross-platform/security red lines, and PR checklist.
- [Product IA Specification](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/docs/PRODUCT-IA.md): Canonical 4+1 functional domain pyramid, adaptive wide/narrow navigation, 4-tier Settings Hub single-source-of-truth spec, and `PreInvocation` zero-token visual receipt contract.
- [Dual-Star File Contract (`agy-NOV` × `agy-Sag`)](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/docs/DUAL-STAR-CONTRACT.md): Canonical zero-port `config.json` hot-sync and `<dataDir>/feed-snapshot.json` read-only snapshot schema (SHA-256 semantic dirty checking ignoring `generatedAt`, immediate `PreToolUse` & CLI mutator refresh, `createdAt`-ordered `latestSnapshotId`, real-deny `GUARD_BLOCKED`, latest-timestamp `verify` summary), `modules/<id>/` path map, redaction rules, and zero-mkdir invariants.
- [AI Agent Install & Verification Guide](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/docs/llms-install.md): Step-by-step zero-risk installation, offline workbench preview, 18-asset + 4-check Marketplace `doctor` pass criteria, zero-global-install CLI commands, consent gates, `.agy-nov.json` scaffold & `.worktreeinclude` rules, and rollback commands.
- [Plugin Entry Skill](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md): Slimmed `9.5 KB` Antigravity 2.0 entry skill instructions (clearing `ops.large-instruction-file` warnings) for invoking `nov_open`, `nov_status`, slash playbooks, read-only subagents, MCP context resources, and modular tools.
- [Changelog](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release history for v1.2.2, v1.2.1, v1.2.0, v1.1.0, v1.0.2, v1.0.1, v1.0.0, v0.9.0, v0.8.0, v0.7.0, v0.6.0, v0.5.0, v0.4.0, v0.3.0, v0.2.0, and v0.1.0.

## Optional

- [On-Demand Playbooks (`skills/nov-*/SKILL.md`)](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/tree/main/skills): `/nov-spec`, `/nov-workflow`, `/nov-debug`, `/nov-review`, and `/nov-handoff` zero-tool-slot slash workflows.
- [Read-Only Specialist Subagents (`agents/*.md`)](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/tree/main/agents): `nov-blind-reviewer` and `nov-security-auditor` independent read-only audit subagents.
- [Read-Only Audit Sidecar Source](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/src/server/sidecar.ts): Core read-only Ops/Mem/Verify/Guard sweep aggregator and guarded `0600` atomic `health-sweep.json` writer (SHA-256 semantic dirty check ignoring `generatedAt`) backing `audit-once` and `sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs`.
- [Shared Loopback `ConversationService` Client Source](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/src/core/conversation-service.ts): Layer 1 loopback-only Connect API client with anti-SSRF validation, `4 MiB` streaming abort, zero CSRF echoing, and full outbound redaction shared across `remote`, `xray`, and `radar`.
- [Spec DAG Workflow Compiler Source](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/src/modules/spec/compiler.ts): Pure read-only Kahn wave layering compiler generating `/run-workflow` Python orchestration and `/swarm` `plan.json` blueprints.
- [Zero-Injection MCP Context Resources Source](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/src/server/context-resources.ts): Module-gated, symlink-safe, linear-redacted `<= 32 KiB` read-only `agy-nov://context/{review,mem,turbo,xray}` handlers.
- [Module Catalog Source](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/src/core/catalog.ts): Canonical definitions for all 13 modules, 4 functional domains, 5 presets, 8 UI locales, 6 hooks, isolation tiers, and 47 model tool names.
- [Dual-Star Feed Snapshot Source](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/src/core/feed.ts): Read-only memory aggregation, O(n) redaction, `< 64 KiB` capping, SHA-256 semantic dirty checking ignoring `generatedAt`, and zero-mkdir conditional atomic writer for `feed-snapshot.json`.
- [Team Preset Parser Source](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/src/core/team-config.ts): Read-only `.agy-nov.json` validation (`<= 64 KiB`, `realpath` containment, prototype-pollution defense, 23-executable static allowlist, never silently enables `remote`).
- [Modular CLI Source](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/blob/main/src/server/cli.ts): Canonical 11 CLI commands (`status`, `enable`, `disable`, `preset`, `locale`, `statusline` with Antigravity 2.35+ / 2.36+ stdin JSON/NDJSON fusion, `remaining_percentage` & 11 segments, `recommend` with `--export-preset` & `~/.gemini > ~/.agents/skills` dedup, `doctor` with 18-asset + 4-check Marketplace verification, `compact-run`, `compile-spec`, `audit-once`).
